diagnostics.summary: argument `receiver` for `collect` uses `take` but the parameter is `read`.

diagnostics.summary: async call `read receiver.recv` must be awaited.
diagnostics.label: async call must be awaited
causes: Async calls introduce suspension boundaries that must be visible in source; `spawn` is reserved but not executable in v0.7.

fixes.title: Write `await read receiver.recv(...)`.

diagnostics.label: value live across await
causes: Suspending an RSScript async frame may keep managed handles and Copy snapshots, but local values, resources, and runtime guards must not be retained across suspension.

fixes.title: End the lifetime of `cancellation_source` before this `await`.
